item.title: [Episode 35] Washington's Noise, Beijing's Telegram ([35화] 워싱턴의 소음, 베이징의 전문)
item.description:
[Episode 35] Washington's Noise, Beijing's Telegram ([35화] 워싱턴의 소음, 베이징의 전문)

☞ View from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Unlike South Korea, where the primary enemy is clear-cut, the Japan business involved geopolitical factors so intricately entangled that it was practically impossible for a working-level official like Evan to set the stage. (주적(主敵)이 명확한 한국과 달리, 일본 사업은 지정학 요소가 한층 더 복잡하게 얽혀 있는 탓에, 에반과 같은 실무급이 판을 짜는 것은 사실상 불가능했다.)

The fury Patrick unleashed in the Arlington conference room was nothing more than theater for effect. (패트릭이 알링턴 회의실에서 뿜은 분노는 연기를 위한 연기였을 뿐.)

In a world where people even consider which country a car comes from before buying it, defense contracts and foreign policy are inevitably a high-dimensional equation, moving in lockstep like a three-legged race. (하물며 자동차 한 대를 살 때도 어느 나라 차인지를 따지는 판에, 방산 계약과 외교 정책은 늘 이인삼각 경기처럼 맞물려 갈 수밖에 없는 고차원 방정식이다.)

In truth, the Dudael executives knew this better than anyone. Untying the Gordian Knot ultimately came down to horse-trading between heads of state. (사실 그건 듀다엘 경영진이 누구보다 잘 알았다. 고르디우스의 매듭을 푸는 것은, 결국 국가 정상 간의 맞교환이라는 것을.)

Alistair, the chairman of Dudael Tech, had decided to serve faithfully as an unofficial messenger on behalf of the government on this complex chessboard. What he demanded from Washington in return was anyone's guess. (듀다엘 테크의 의장인 앨리스터는 이 복잡한 체스판에서, 정부를 대신해 비공식 메신저 역할에 충실하기로 했다. 그 대가로 워싱턴에 무엇을 요구했는지는 알 길이 없지만.)

Alistair used his mansion in McLean, Virginia, as a venue to relay unofficial government messages, much like a presidential retreat. (앨리스터는 버지니아주 맥클린 저택을 대통령 별장처럼 정부의 비공식 메시지를 전달하는 장소로 썼다.)

Of course, someone of Alistair's standing could have established himself in Florida, the Hamptons, or Nantucket, but he believed the safest place on Earth was McLean, five minutes from Langley. (물론, 앨리스터 정도의 위치라면 플로리다에도, 햄프턴스에도, 낸터킷에 자리 잡을 수도 있었겠지만, 지구상에서 가장 안전한 곳은 랭리에서 5분 거리인 이곳 맥클린이라고 그는 믿었다.)

A place where Washington's political noise, crossing the Potomac River, was swallowed up and extinguished by the woods. Alistair was savoring the lush greenery of late summer outside his second-floor study in the grand forest estate when the doorbell rang, and he slowly turned around. (워싱턴의 정치적 소음이 포토맥강을 건너오다 숲에 가로막혀 소멸하는 곳. 앨리스터는 울창한 숲속 대저택의 2층 서재에서 창밖의 늦여름의 푸릇함을 만끽하다가, 초인종이 울리자 천천히 몸을 돌렸다.)

"Welcome, Minister Chen. Thank you for making the trip all the way to McLean." (“어서 오십시오, 천 공사님. 맥클린까지 오시느라 고생하셨습니다.”)

Chen Wei, the Commercial Counselor at the Chinese Embassy in Washington, had rushed over at Alistair's invitation from a few days earlier. He seemed to have expected some good news. He was a veteran diplomat from the Communist Youth League, an unofficial party messenger who moved deftly between the hawkish faction toward the U.S. and the pragmatic line. (주미 중국 대사관 상무공사 천웨이는 며칠 전 앨리스터의 초청을 받고 한걸음에 달려왔다. 무언가 희소식을 기대한 모양이었다. 그는 공청단 출신 베테랑 외교관으로, 대미 강경파와 실용주의 노선 사이를 능숙하게 오가는 당의 비공식 메신저였다.)

Counselor Chen, wearing a tailored suit, a blue tie, and a smile that would suit any lobbyist on K Street, gave Alistair a slight nod. (천 공사는 맞춤 수트, 파란 넥타이, 그리고 K 스트리트의 어느 로비스트에게나 어울릴 법한 미소를 입고, 앨리스터에게 가볍게 목례했다.)

It was a greeting honed over ten years on American soil. (미국 땅에서 10년을 갈고닦은 인사법이었다.)

"Thank you for the invitation. As the rumors say, this place is a fortress." (“초대해 주셔서 감사합니다. 소문대로 요새 같은 곳이군요.”)

"Apologies if it felt uncomfortable. As you know, these days there are far too many uninvited guests roaming about." (“불편하셨다면 사과드립니다. 아시다시피, 요즘 세상엔 너무 많은 초대받지 않은 손님들이 돌아다니니까요.”)

Alistair smiled warmly and led Chen Wei toward the window. (앨리스터는 사람 좋은 미소를 지으며 천웨이를 창가로 안내했다.)

"Many people keep estates in Palm Beach or Malibu, but I love McLean the most. There's no place on Earth where security is as guaranteed as here." (“많은 사람이 팜비치나 말리부에 별장을 두곤 하지만, 저는 맥클린을 가장 사랑합니다. 지구상에서 여기만큼 안전이 보장된 곳은 없으니까요.”)

Chen Wei glanced up at the sky outside and fired off a barbed joke. (천웨이는 창밖의 하늘을 올려다보며 뼈 있는 농담을 던졌다.)

"Indeed... at least there's no chance of another plane flying into this sky." (“확실히…… 적어도 이 하늘에 다시 비행기가 날아와 꽂히는 일은 없겠군요.”)

At the 9/11 joke, the kind a British comedian might crack, Alistair let out a hearty laugh like an audience member dragged along unwillingly. (영국 코미디언이나 던질 법한 9·11 농담에, 앨리스터는 억지로 끌려온 관객처럼 너털웃음을 지었다.)

"You've been in America so long you've picked up Western humor. But this is no laughing matter. Do you know something? Even the faint warmth of this teacup we're holding might be read by satellites beyond the atmosphere." (“미국에 오래 계시더니 서구 유머까지 갖추셨군요. 허나 농담으로만 넘길 일은 아닙니다. 혹시 아십니까? 지금 우리가 든 이 찻잔의 미세한 열기마저, 저 대기권 밖의 위성이 읽어내고 있을지.”)

He raised his gaze as if piercing through the ceiling into the sky. (천장 너머 하늘을 꿰뚫어 보듯 시선을 올렸다.)

"If you knew how dense and thick the layer of surveillance covering the skies above McLean is... you'd understand what I mean." (“이 맥클린의 상공을 덮고 있는 감시의 레이어가 얼마나 촘촘하고 두터운지 아신다면…… 제 말이 무슨 뜻인지 이해하실 겁니다.”)

Alistair leisurely transferred tea leaves into the strainer with a wooden spoon. (앨리스터는 여유롭게 찻잎을 나무 수저로 거름망에 옮겼다.)

"How is the taste? Most Westerners divide tea into black-and-white logic. Unfermented green tea, or fully oxidized black tea. They're only used to the extremes." (“맛이 어떻습니까? 보통 서양인들은 차를 흑백 논리로 나누죠. 발효시키지 않은 녹차, 아니면 완전히 산화시킨 홍차. 양극단에만 익숙해져 있습니다.”)

The secretary poured warm water, and for thirty seconds, the two silently watched the aroma of the first infusion spread through the study. (비서가 따뜻한 물을 붓고, 30초 동안 두 사람은 아무 말 없이 첫 번째 우림의 향이 서재에 퍼지는 것을 지켜봤다.)

"But what captured my palate is something that lingers in between. A semi-fermented tea that holds both the freshness of green tea and the depth of black tea. Most call it oolong, but I prefer that subtle nuance of 'qing cha' — blue-green tea." (“허나 제 입맛을 사로잡은 건 그 경계에 머물러 있는 녀석입니다. 녹차의 신선함과 홍차의 깊이를 동시에 품은 반발효차. 흔히 우롱차라 부르지만, 저는 청차(靑茶)라는 그 오묘한 어감을 더 아낍니다.”)

Alistair handed over a teacup. (앨리스터가 찻잔을 건넸다.)

"A flavor of exquisite moderation, not fully green as its name suggests. Doesn't it resemble the aesthetics of diplomacy, which must strike a balance between black and white?" (“이름만큼 완전히 푸르지도 않은 절묘한 중용의 맛. 흑과 백 사이에서 균형을 잡아야 하는 외교의 미학과도 닮아 있지 않습니까?”)

With deft hands, he poured hot water and steeped the leaves. A soft yet weighty orchid fragrance filled the study. (그는 능숙한 손놀림으로 뜨거운 물을 붓고 찻잎을 우려냈다. 은은하면서도 묵직한 난초 향이 서재를 채웠다.)

"This is Fenghuang Dancong Song Zhong. Leaves picked from thousand-year-old tea trees on Fenghuang Mountain in Guangdong Province." (“봉화단총 송종(宋種)입니다. 광둥성 봉황산의 천년 된 고차수에서 딴 잎이죠.”)

He slid the teacup toward Chen Wei. (찻잔을 천웨이 앞으로 밀었다.)

"Do you know why this tea is called Song Zhong? Because it descends from a varietal cherished by the Song Dynasty emperors. I have a great fondness for the Song Dynasty in Chinese history." (“이 차의 이름이 왜 송종인지 아십니까? 송나라 황제들이 아꼈던 품종의 후예이기 때문입니다. 저는 중국 역사에서 송나라를 참 좋아합니다.”)

Chen Wei lifted the warm cup and savored the subtle aroma of the qing cha. But his eyes turned cold. (천웨이는 따뜻한 찻잔을 들어 청차의 은은한 향을 음미했다. 하지만 눈빛은 차갑게 가라앉았다.)

"Instead of wasting national strength on reckless wars, the wisdom of buying peace with money might be today's lesson. Thanks to that, culture flourished, and even a thousand years later, we can still drink this tea, can't we." (“무리한 전쟁으로 국력을 낭비하는 대신, 평화를 돈으로 사는 지혜가 오늘날 교훈이 아닐까 싶습니다. 덕분에 문화가 꽃피었고, 천년이 지난 지금도 우리가 이 차를 마실 수 있게 되지 않았습니까.”)

"The fragrance is exquisite. But Alistair, you've overlooked one thing." (“향이 일품이군요. 하지만 앨리스터, 하나 간과하신 게 있습니다.”)

He set down the cup and retorted toward Alistair. (찻잔을 내려놓으며 앨리스터를 향해 대꾸했다.)

"The figure the Chinese admire most in Song Dynasty history is not an emperor. It's General Yue Fei." (“중국인들이 송나라 역사에서 가장 존경하는 인물은 황제가 아닙니다. 악비(岳飛) 장군이죠.”)

"Yue Fei... You mean the tragic general." (“악비라…… 비운의 장군 말씀입니까.")

"A hero who chose death over kneeling to the barbarians and fought to the end. We call that spirit the soul of China." (“오랑캐에게 무릎 꿇느니 죽음을 택하겠다며 끝까지 싸운 영웅입니다. 우리는 그 기개를 중화의 혼이라 부르죠.”)

Chen Wei paused for a beat and continued. (천웨이가 한 박자 쉬고 말을 이어갔다.)

"Peace is not bought with money; it's defended with blood." (“평화는 돈으로 사는 게 아니라, 피로 지키는 법입니다.”)

It was small talk empty of a single lie. Chen Wei had chilled the cordial atmosphere in an instant. (한 방울의 거짓도 담지 않은 한담이었다. 천웨이는 이 화기애애한 분위기를 순식간에 식혀 버렸다.)

As Alistair set down his cup, the temperature in the room dropped with it. (앨리스터가 찻잔을 내려놓자, 방 안의 온도가 함께 내려갔다.)

"Yue Fei's spirit is admirable, but reality is harsh. Let me get to the point." (“악비의 기개는 훌륭하지만, 현실은 냉혹하죠. 본론을 말씀드리겠습니다.”)

"We are finalizing a plan to elevate Japan's Shirakawa Heavy Industries beyond simple maintenance for the U.S. Seventh Fleet, into a strategic logistics base and new shipbuilding partner for the U.S. Navy. I'm also informing you in advance that the Sariel system will be fitted on those warships." (“미 7함대의 단순 정비를 넘어, 일본 시라카와 중공업을 미 해군의 전략적 병참 기지이자 신조함 건조 파트너로 격상하는 방안을 최종 조율 중입니다. 그 군함들에 사리엘을 장착하게 되는 점도 미리 말씀드립니다.”)

Chen Wei's expression hardened. The Sariel introduction was expected, but shipbuilding and logistics basing were a different matter entirely. (천웨이의 표정이 딱딱하게 굳었다. 사리엘 도입은 예상했지만, 함정 건조와 병참 기지화는 차원이 다른 문제였다.)

"That... is crossing a river with no return, Alistair." (“그건…… 돌아올 수 없는 강을 건너는 겁니다, 앨리스터.”)

His voice trembled low. (목소리가 낮게 떨렸다.)

"This is an act that shatters the balance of East Asia. Do you think Beijing will sit idly by? I no longer have any grounds to persuade the hawks back home." (“동아시아의 균형을 무너뜨리는 행위입니다. 베이징이 가만히 있을 거라 생각합니까? 나도 본국의 강경파들을 더는 설득할 명분이 없습니다.”)

"That's exactly why I invited you today." (“그래서 오늘 모신 겁니다.”)

Alistair leisurely lifted the teapot and refilled his own cup. (앨리스터는 여유롭게 찻주전자를 들어 자신의 잔을 채웠다.)

"Rather than being caught off guard reading this story on the front page of the Wall Street Journal, wouldn't it look better for the capable Counselor Chen to cable it directly to your home country as a diplomatic telegram? This is a courtesy from me." (“월스트리트저널 1면에서 이 기사를 접하고 당황하시는 것보다는, 유능하신 천 공사님이 본국에 직접 외교 전문으로 타전하는 게 모양새가 좋지 않겠습니까? 이건 제가 드리는 배려입니다.”)

"A courtesy." (“배려라.”)

Chen Wei echoed. His lips pressed tightly together. This wasn't a negotiation. It was a notification. (천웨이가 되뇌었다. 입술이 지그시 깨물렸다. 이것은 협상이 아니었다. 통보였다.)

"...This tea tastes rather bitter after all." (“……이 차 맛은 생각보다 꽤 쓰군요.")

Chen Wei set down his unfinished cup and rose from his seat. (천웨이는 다 마시지 못한 찻잔을 내려놓고 자리에서 일어났다.)

item.title: Park Beom-kye "Jung Cheong-rae, Claim That Myeong-Cheong Battle Is Fiction? That Statement Is Fiction... It Originated Because of Jung" (박범계 “정청래, 명청대전이 허구? 그 말이 허구...鄭 탓에 생긴 말”)
item.description:
Park Beom-kye "Jung Cheong-rae, Claim That Myeong-Cheong Battle Is Fiction? That Statement Is Fiction... It Originated Because of Jung" (박범계 “정청래, 명청대전이 허구? 그 말이 허구...鄭 탓에 생긴 말” )

<<>> Democratic Party lawmaker Park Beom-kye responded to party leadership candidate Jung Cheong-rae's recent remark that the so-called 'Myeong-Cheong conflict' is "a fiction that does not exist," saying, "The Myeong-Cheong battle was a natural term coined by pro-Myeong supporters who back the president" and "that statement (Jung's claim that the Myeong-Cheong battle does not exist) is the fiction." ()

Park, who is backing candidate Kim Min-seok, said on CBS Radio's 'Park Jae-hong's One-on-One Show' on the night of the 4th, "The term Myeong-Cheong battle was not coined by candidate Kim Min-seok. It was a natural term created by many so-called pro-Myeong supporters who support President (Lee Jae-myung)." Park added, "Until before the June 13 local elections, President Lee Jae-myung's authority over so-called state affairs momentum was immense. But after the local election results came out, the opposition's voice grew louder. They began nitpicking and criticizing President Lee Jae-myung on every issue." He then said, "The person who commanded that election was (candidate Jung)" and "The local election results ultimately became the catalyst for the president's governing momentum and authority to be questioned and criticized." (박범계 더불어민주당 의원은 정청래 당 대표 후보가 최근 이른바 ‘명청 갈등’을 두고 “존재하지 않는 허구”라고 한 데 대해 “명청대전은 대통령을 지지하는, 친명 지지자들이 만들어낸 자연스러운 용어였다”며 “그 말(명청 대전이 없다는 정 후보 발언)이 허구”라고 했다.)

Park said, "Candidate Kim spent 18 years (away from the party) as a political outsider, not even an unemployed person but a retired political figure, enduring difficult times" and "Using a person's extremely hard period as a target of criticism is a truly heartless attitude." (김민석 후보를 지지하고 있는 박 의원은 4일 밤 CBS라디오 ‘박재홍의 한판 승부’에서 “명청대전이라는 거는 김민석 후보가 만들어낸 용어가 아니다. (이재명) 대통령을 지지하는 많은 소위 친명 지지자들이 만들어낸 자연스러운 용어였다”고 했다. 박 의원은 “6·13 지방선거가 있기 전까지 이재명 대통령의 소위 국정 동력에 대한 권위가 굉장했다.그런데 지방선거 결과가 나온 이후로 야당의 목소리가 커졌습니다. 사사건건 트집을 잡아서 이재명 대통령을 비난하기 시작했다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “그 선거를 지휘한 사람이 (정 후보)”라며 “대통령의 국정 운영의 동력과 권위가 결국은 의심받고 비판받는 계기가 지방 선거 결과였다”고 했다.)

Recently, candidate Jung criticized Kim for leaving the Democratic Party in 2002 to join Chung Mong-joon's camp after advocating for a Roh Moo-hyun-Chung Mong-joon candidate unification ahead of that year's presidential election, saying, "There is no limit to betrayal" and "Someone who betrayed once will betray again." (박 의원은 “김 후보는 (당을 떠난) 18년 동안 말 그대로 백수도 아닌 퇴수, 정치적 야인으로 어려운 시절을 보냈다”며 “한 인간으로서 굉장히 어려웠던 시절을 비난의 대상으로 삼는 건 참으로 몰인정한 태도”라고 했다.)

In response, Park said, "In 2008, President Roh Moo-hyun also wrote in his autobiography that 'we have officially reconciled historically.'" He continued, "Does candidate Jung really have the qualification to make such an assessment about a person's life?" and "Using such excessive language is not acceptable." (최근 정 후보는 김 후보가 2002년 대선 당시 노무현·정몽준 후보 단일화를 주장하며 민주당을 탈당해 정몽준 캠프에 합류한 것을 두고 “배신에는 총량이 없다”며 “한 번 배신한 사람은 또 배신한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Organizations Can't Beat Momentum"... On Pro-Lee Additional Voting Push, "A Voting Coup" (정청래 “조직은 바람 못 이겨”...친명계 추가 투표 주장엔 “투표 쿠데타”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Organizations Can't Beat Momentum"... On Pro-Lee Additional Voting Push, "A Voting Coup" (정청래 “조직은 바람 못 이겨”...친명계 추가 투표 주장엔 “투표 쿠데타”)

Jung Cheong-rae, a candidate in the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea leadership election, characterized this party convention as "a fight between organization and momentum" and said on the 5th that "organizations can never beat momentum." (8·17 더불어민주당 당대표 선거에 출마한 정청래 후보는 이번 전당대회를 “조직이냐 바람이냐의 싸움”이라고 규정하면서 “조직은 절대 바람을 이기지 못한다”고 5일 말했다.)

Speaking on Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel, Jung said, "It's a clash between the spontaneous drive of people asking, 'Isn't this too much? Did Jung Cheong-rae commit a sin worthy of death?' and an organization that, while the media bombs away, unilaterally fosters an atmosphere that 'Jung Cheong-rae won't make it.'" Having visited Gwangju in South Jeolla Province the previous day, Jung added, "I came back with the firm belief from Gwangju that 'just as Roh Moo-hyun beat Lee In-je in 2002, Jung Cheong-rae's momentum will beat Kim Min-seok's organization.'" (정 후보는 이날 김어준씨 유튜브에서 “‘너무 심한 거 아니야? 정청래가 죽을 죄 지었나?’ 하는 자발적 동력과, 언론이 융단 폭격하면서 일방적으로 ‘정청래는 안 될 것’이라는 분위기를 조장하는 조직이 싸움을 붙은 것”이라면서 이같이 말했다. 전날 전남광주를 찾았던 정 후보는 “광주에서 ’2002년 노무현이 이인제를 이겼듯 정청래의 바람이 김민석의 조직을 이길 것 같다’는 확실한 믿음을 갖고 왔다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung) supreme council candidates' claim that the structure in which the vote of party members with voting rights closes before the regional joint speeches should be adjusted—and their push for an additional vote—Jung called it a "voting coup." He said, "No voting system like this exists anywhere in the world. If we do this, we should keep voting until we reach the 100% party-wide vote that candidate Kim Min-seok talks about." He added, "The vote is over, but proposing another voting opportunity is a post-hoc vote." He also said, "The rules can't be changed. If this happens, there will be an uprising." (한편 정 후보는 친명(친이재명)계 최고위원 후보들이 권역별 합동연설회 전 권리당원 투표가 마감되는 구조를 조정해야 한다며 추가 투표를 주장한 데 대해 “투표 쿠데타”라고 했다. 정 후보는 “이렇게 하는 투표는 전세계 어디에도 없다. 그럼 김민석 후보가 말하는 전 당원 100% 투표가 될 때까지 투표해야 한다”면서 “투표가 끝났는데 다시 투표 기회를 주자는 건 사후 투표”라고 했다. 또 “(룰은) 못 바꾼다. 이렇게 되면 폭동이 일어난다”고도 했다.)

Targeting Kim Min-seok's history of leaving the party, Jung said, "There's no limit to the total amount of betrayal. Once you betray, you can betray again," and urged, "Party members, please protect Jung Cheong-rae." (정 후보는 김민석 후보의 탈당 전력을 겨냥해 “배신 총량은 리미트(한계)가 없다. 한 번 배신하면 또 배신할 수 있다”면서 “당원들은 정청래를 지켜달라”고 했다.)

On the possibility of ultimately losing under the preferential voting system, Jung said, "I would of course accept the result." He then appealed to his supporters, "Please make me a comfortable first-place winner with a majority." <<>> (정 후보는 선호투표제 하에서 결과적으로 패배할 경우에 대해선 “당연히 승복한다”고 했다. 그러면서 지지자들을 향해 “나를 과반으로 넉넉하게 1등을 만들어달라”고 했다.)

item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "Lee Administration's 'Goryeo-Jang Tax Law'... Telling 60s-70s to Sell Their Homes and Leave" (안철수 “李정부의 ‘고려장 세법’…6070에게 집 팔고 떠나라는 것“)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo: "Lee Administration's 'Goryeo-Jang Tax Law'... Telling 60s-70s to Sell Their Homes and Leave" (안철수 “李정부의 ‘고려장 세법’…6070에게 집 팔고 떠나라는 것“)

People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo on the 5th demanded the scrapping of the government's real estate tax reform proposal, calling it a "Goryeo-Jang tax amendment that tells seniors in their 60s and 70s in Seoul's Gangnam 3 districts to sell their homes and leave the capital area." (국민의힘 안철수 의원이 5일 정부의 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 “서울 강남 3구 6070에게 집 팔고 수도권 떠나라는 ‘고려장 세법 개정안’”이라며 파기를 요구했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, Ahn stated, "The core of the Lee Jae-myung administration's real estate tax reform is concentrated taxation on ultra-high-value homes and increased taxes on owners of non-resident properties." Earlier, the government announced a reform plan that sharply raises taxes on non-resident and ultra-high-value single-home owners while drastically reducing deduction benefits for owners who have held apartments for 20 to 30 years or more. In response, concerns have been raised that the biggest victims of the plan would not be multi-home speculators but elderly residents who have lived in the same neighborhood for decades. <<> Ahn said, "If the tax reform is implemented, seniors in their 60s and 70s in Seoul will take a direct hit." He added, "Through concentrated taxation on ultra-high-value homes and increased taxes on non-resident property owners, the government has significantly raised the comprehensive real estate tax for those holding homes worth 3.2 billion won or more. The key is that in the long-term holding special deduction, 'holding' has been removed and only 'residence' is allowed, with the capital gains tax deduction cap set at 1 billion won." <<> He continued, "Are they trying to drive all the elderly out of Seoul and give their homes to whom?" and "The 'Goryeo-Jang tax amendment' packaged with taxes and regulations for political purposes should be scrapped without any discussion—that is the answer." <<> Bae Jun-young, the People Power Party's secretary on the National Assembly's Strategy and Finance Committee, also appeared on a radio program that day and said, "This is telling seniors in their 60s and 70s living in the capital area to sell their expensive homes and move to non-capital regions." Bae noted, "These days, many people retire around age 55 and struggle through a second job with low income of about 2 million won until they start receiving pensions at 65. Even if they own one home of high value, many have poor incomes." He added, "Raising property taxes is forcing these people to sell their homes. Wasn't it the Democratic Party government that made their homes expensive in the first place? Is it right to raise housing prices with bad policies and then treat them this way?" <<> On the same day, People Power Party lawmaker Kim Eun-hye proposed a so-called "Single-Homeowner Capital Gains Tax Bomb Prevention Act." The bill, a partial amendment to the Income Tax Act, would allow single-homeowners to deduct property taxes and comprehensive real estate taxes paid during their holding period when calculating capital gains from the sale of their home. <<> Kim explained the reason for proposing the amendment, stating, "With the Lee Jae-myung administration's punitive tax reform, even citizens who have held a single home long-term are at risk of bearing excessive tax burdens," and "Deducting the property taxes and comprehensive real estate taxes already paid in good faith during the holding period from capital gains calculations is the bare minimum of common sense to correct tax fairness and ease the burden of double taxation." (안 의원은 이날 오전 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “이재명 정부 부동산 세제 개편의 핵심은 초고가 주택 집중 과세 및 비거주 주택 보유자에 대한 세금 가중”이라며 이같이 밝혔다. 앞서 정부는 비거주·초고가 1주택자의 세금을 대폭 올리고 20~30년 이상 아파트를 장기 보유한 소유자에게 주던 공제 혜택을 대거 축소하는 내용의 개편안을 발표했다. 이를 두고 개편안의 최대 피해자가 다주택 투기 세력이 아니라 수십 년을 한 동네에서 살아온 고령층이 될 것이란 지적이 나왔다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk Blames Blue House for 'Leverage ETF' Mess: "Kim Yong-beom Cannot Slip Away" (조국 ‘레버리지 ETF’두고 靑 책임론 “김용범 어물쩍 넘길 수 없어”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk Blames Blue House for 'Leverage ETF' Mess: "Kim Yong-beom Cannot Slip Away" (조국 ‘레버리지 ETF’두고 靑 책임론 “김용범 어물쩍 넘길 수 없어”)

Cho Kuk, director of the Innovation Policy Research Institute under the Rebuilding Korea Party, said on the 5th, "Since the ruling Democratic Party is staying silent, I will speak clearly from a 'red team' perspective," arguing that "the government's introduction of single-stock leverage ETFs is a clear policy failure." He further stated, "The current situation is a 'failure of state-directed finance' created by the core policy officials led by Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, including the Blue House policy office, the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Financial Services Commission, and the Financial Supervisory Service," and insisted that they must be held accountable. <<> In a Facebook post that day, Director Cho said, "After Policy Chief Kim held an informal meeting with heads of securities firms and asset management companies on January 13 this year, the Financial Services Commission pushed ahead with a legislative notice on January 30," adding, "Subsequently, the enforcement decree of the Capital Markets Act was passed at a Cabinet meeting on April 21, and the products were listed on the market on May 27." <<> He continued, "There were experts who pointed out it was premature, but the Blue House policy chief insisted on the introduction and stirred up momentum, and 16 single-stock leverage ETFs hit the market right before the June 3 election. However, after the election, on June 22, Financial Supervisory Service Governor Lee Bok-hyun made remarks saying, 'I should have blocked it by lying down and refusing to budge.' One cannot help but call this policy decision process a 'mystery.'" <<> He noted, "In particular, looking at the press release distributed by the Financial Services Commission on April 21 titled 'Cabinet Resolution of the Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Capital Markets Act to Resolve Asymmetric Regulation Between Domestic and Overseas-Listed ETFs,' it appears there was no sufficient discussion of policy side effects at that Cabinet meeting," adding, "In the publicly disclosed minutes, the Prime Minister presided due to the President's overseas trip, and under 'discussion' regarding the resolution of the enforcement decree, it was recorded as 'no objections.'" <<> He then said, "One cannot help but wonder why the government carelessly and hastily rushed the 'money move' from real estate to the stock market," and "62% of the accounts forcibly liquidated belonged to young people aged 35 and under. The young people who invested trusting the government's resolve have fallen into the leverage trap laid by the government, ending up with lifelong trauma and debt that can never be erased." <<> He asked, "Will the government just tell them, 'We provided warnings about the risks'?" adding, "On the other hand, a small number of forces who reaped enormous speculative profits by riding the extreme volatility have been observed triggering a 'reverse money move,' pouring the massive liquidity swept up from the stock market back into the real estate market." <<> Director Cho said, "Policy Chief Kim, along with Office for Government Policy Coordination Chief Yoon Chang-ryeol, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Bok-hyun, and FSS Governor Lee Bok-hyun, must each be held accountable," and "The entire process from start to finish—including the incomprehensible 'mysterious' introduction process, the belated response that worsened the damage, and the ineffective patchwork measures—must be fully revealed, and those responsible must take responsibility." He also stated, "The government must return to the 'original intent' of its goal of a 'KOSPI 5,000 era.' In particular, it must resolve the lives of young people who entered the leverage trap in an attempt to escape the quagmire of extreme inequality," adding, "The government should not be one that encourages young people to invest in stocks, but one that invests in young people." (조국 조국혁신당 혁신정책연구원장은 5일 “집권 민주당이 침묵하고 있기에 ‘레드팀’ 입장에서 분명히 말한다”며 “정부의 단일종목 레버리지ETF도입은 명백한 정책 실패”라고 주장했다. 그러면서 “작금의 사태는 청와대 정책실, 국무조정실, 금융위원회, 금융감독원 등 김용범 정책실장을 필두로 한 정부의 정책 핵심들이 만들어낸 ‘관치 금융의 실패”라며 이들에 대한 책임을 물어야 한다고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok and Jung Cheong-rae in virtual tie within margin of error... Kim surpasses majority among ruling party supporters [KSOI] (김민석·정청래 오차범위 내 초접전...與 지지층선 金 과반 [KSOI])
item.description:
Kim Min-seok and Jung Cheong-rae in virtual tie within margin of error... Kim surpasses majority among ruling party supporters [KSOI] (김민석·정청래 오차범위 내 초접전...與 지지층선 金 과반 [KSOI])

A poll showed that Kim Min-seok and Jung Cheong-rae, both candidates in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party leadership election, are in a near dead heat within the margin of error. Among Democratic Party supporters, Kim far outpaced Jung with majority support. (더불어민주당 8·17 당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 후보와 정청래 후보가 오차 범위 내 초접전을 벌이고 있다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 민주당 지지층 사이에선 김 후보가 과반의 지지율로 정 후보를 크게 앞섰다.)

According to a survey conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 3rd and 4th of this month targeting 1,002 adults nationwide on suitability for Democratic Party leadership, Kim Min-seok received 28.1%, Jung Cheong-rae 27.6%, and Song Young-gil 4.8%. The gap between Kim and Song was 0.5 percentage points (p), within the margin of sampling error (±3.1%p). (한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)가 3~4일 전국 성인 1002명을 대상으로 실시한 민주당 당대표 적합도 조사 결과 김민석 후보 28.1%, 정청래 후보 27.6%, 송영길 후보 4.8%로 집계됐다. 김 후보와 송 후보 간 격차는 0.5%포인트(p)로 표본 오차(±3.1%p) 안이었다.)

Among Democratic Party supporters, Kim led with 51.1%, ahead of Jung Cheong-rae (31.4%) by a 19.7%p margin. Song received 5.5%. The Democratic Party leadership election combines 70% from rights-bearing party member voting and 30% from a public opinion poll. (민주당 지지층에선 김 후보가 51.1%로 정청래 후보(31.4%)를 19.7%p 차이로 크게 앞섰다. 송 후보는 5.5%였다. 민주당 당대표 선거는 권리당원 투표 70%, 국민 여론조사 30%를 합산한다.)

By region, in Gwangju and Jeolla, the party's core support base, Kim received 42.6%, 20.6%p higher than Jung (22%). In Seoul, however, Jung led with 27.5% over Kim (25%), and in Gyeonggi and Incheon, Jung (32%) also outpaced Kim (23%) by a 9%p margin. (지역별로는 민주당 핵심 지지층인 광주·전라에서 김 후보가 42.6%로 정 후보(22%)보다 20.6%p 높았다. 반면 서울에서는 정 후보가 27.5%로 김 후보(25%)를 앞섰고, 경기·인천에서도 정 후보(32%)가 김 후보(23%)를 9%p 차로 앞질렀다.)

This survey was conducted using wireless automated response (ARS) methods, with a margin of error of ±3.1%p at a 95% confidence level and a response rate of 5.7%. For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. (이번 조사는 무선 자동응답(ARS) 방식으로 실시됐고, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에서 ±3.1%p, 응답률은 5.7%다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Han Byeong-do: "Pursue Tax Normalization and Supply Expansion Together... People Power Party's 'Unquestioning' Criticism" (한병도 “세제정상화·공급확대 함께 추진…국힘 ‘묻지마’ 비판”)
item.description:
Han Byeong-do: "Pursue Tax Normalization and Supply Expansion Together... People Power Party's 'Unquestioning' Criticism" (한병도 “세제정상화·공급확대 함께 추진…국힘 ‘묻지마’ 비판”)

Han Byeong-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said regarding the government's real estate tax reform plan, "They claim it's just raising taxes without supply measures, but taxes and supply are not a matter of choosing one over the other," adding, "The People Power Party is firing up their unconditional criticism." (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 정부 부동산 세제 개편안에 대해 “공급 대책 없이 세금만 올린다고 주장하지만 세제와 공급은 양자택일의 문제가 아니다”라며 “국민의힘은 묻지 마 비판에 열을 올리고 있다”고 했다.)

At the Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the morning of the 5th, Floor Leader Han said, "(The tax reform plan) is a fair and reasonable tax normalization process that protects genuine buyers and corrects the distorted taxation structure." He added, "President Lee Jae-myung presided over a real estate and stock market review meeting for over seven hours with the Prime Minister, relevant ministers, and working-level officials in attendance," and "The Democratic Party will also mobilize all relevant standing committees to expand and reorganize the 'Housing Market Stabilization Task Force.'" (한 원내대표는 5일 오전 국회 최고위원회의에서 “(세제 개편안은) 실수요자를 보호하고 왜곡된 과세 구조를 바로잡는 공정하고 합리적인 세제 정상화 과정”이라고 했다. 이어 “이재명 대통령은 국무총리와 관계 부처 장관 및 실무자가 참여한 가운데 7시간이 넘도록 부동산 및 주식 시장 점검회의를 주재했다”며 “민주당도 관련 상임위를 총동원해 ‘주택시장 안정화TF’를 확대·개편 운영하겠다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Han said, "We will roll up our sleeves to prepare necessary supplementary measures based on the voices of the people and concrete cases from the field," and "We will pursue tax normalization and rapid supply expansion together to create a real estate policy the public can trust." (한 원내대표는 “국민 목소리와 현장의 구체적 사례를 바탕으로 필요한 보완책 마련에도 팔을 걷어붙이겠다”며 “세제 정상화와 신속한 공급 확대를 함께 추진해 국민이 신뢰할 수 있는 부동산 정책을 만들겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the abolition of supplementary investigation rights and the expansion of grounds for dismissal of prosecution, Floor Leader Han said, "We are taking the desperate appeals and concerns of crime victims and their bereaved families seriously." He continued, "What victims are asking for is not to protect the authority of any one institution, but to establish a stronger re-review mechanism that can re-examine and correct errors when the state's initial judgment is wrong," and "We will use that demand as the standard for follow-up legislation." (한 원내대표는 이날 보완수사권 폐지 및 공소기각 요건 확대를 담은 형사소송법 개정에 대해선 “범죄 피해자와 유가족이 보내는 절박한 호소와 우려에 대해 무겁게 받아들이고 있다”고 말했다. 이어 그는 “피해자가 요구하는 것이 어느 한 기관의 권한을 지켜달라는 것이 아니라 국가의 첫 판단이 잘못됐을 때 그 오류를 다시 확인하고 바로잡을 더 강력한 재검토 장치를 마련해 달라는 것”이라며 “그 요구를 후속 입법 기준으로 삼겠다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Han said, "We will form a task force to strengthen the rights of vulnerable crime victims and listen directly to the voices of victims, bereaved families, and support organizations." He added, "We will prevent delayed investigations, negligent investigations, and the shelving of cases, and ensure that victims' rights to file objections and access records are actually guaranteed in the field." (한 원내대표는 “사회적 약자 범죄 피해자 권리 강화TF를 구성해 피해자와 유가족, 지원 단체의 목소리를 직접 듣겠다”고 했다. 그는 “수사 지연과 부실 수사, 사건 암장을 막고 피해자의 이의 신청권과 기록 열람권이 현장에서 실질적으로 보장되도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Targeting the People Power Party, he said, "As if they were waiting for this, they forcibly link the criminal justice system to the president and drag out ugly words like 'abolition of the regime' and 'impeachment,'" calling it "malicious political attacks and blatant propaganda that stokes public anxiety." He also said, "The dismissal of prosecution provision is not a clause that erases a specific person's guilt." (그는 국민의힘를 겨냥해 “기다렸다는 듯 형사사법 체계를 대통령과 억지로 연결하며 ‘정권 폐지’ ‘탄핵’ 같은 온갖 흉한 말을 들먹인다”며 “악의적 정치공세이자 국민의 불안을 부추기는 명백한 흑색선전”이라고 했다. “공소기각 조항은 특정인의 죄를 지우는 조항이 아니다”라고도 했다.)

Floor Leader Han said, "Portraying even the court's judgment as an action for the president is irresponsible incitement that denies the independence of the judiciary itself." (한 원내대표는 “법원의 판단까지 대통령을 위한 조치인양 몰고 가는 것은 사법부의 독립마저 부정하는 무책임한 선동”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Defense Ministry: "OPCON Transition, Target Year Decision Possible This Fall... Dialogue with US Through Multiple Channels" (국방부 “전작권 전환, 올 가을 목표 연도 결정 가능…美와 여러 채널로 대화”)
item.description:
Defense Ministry: "OPCON Transition, Target Year Decision Possible This Fall... Dialogue with US Through Multiple Channels" (국방부 “전작권 전환, 올 가을 목표 연도 결정 가능…美와 여러 채널로 대화”)

The government, which is pushing for the early transition of wartime operational control (OPCON), has reaffirmed its plan to decide the final transition timing at the South Korea-US Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) scheduled for this fall. (조기 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환을 추진하고 있는 정부가 올해 가을에 열릴 예정인 한미안보협의회(SCM)에서 최종 전환 시기를 결정하겠다는 방침을 재확인했다.)

It also plans to conduct some assessments related to meeting the conditions for OPCON transition during this month's regular ROK-US combined exercise, the Ulchi Freedom Shield (UFS). (이달 있을 정례 한미연합훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS·을지프리덤실드) 연습에서도 전작권 전환 조건 충족과 관련한 평가를 일부 진행하겠다는 계획이다.)

The Ministry of National Defense reported this at a policy briefing for foreign affairs and security ministries held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae on the morning of the 5th, stating that it will complete the roadmap for the recovery of wartime operational control this year. It also said it will push for the verification of Full Operational Capability (FOC) of the future Combined Forces Command and the decision on the timing of OPCON recovery at this year's SCM. (국방부는 5일 오전 청와대에서 진행된 외교안보부처 업무보고에서 올해 전작권 회복 로드맵을 완성하겠다며 이 같이 보고했다. 올해 SCM에서 미래연합사령부 완전운용능력(FOC) 검증 및 전작권 회복 시기 결정을 추진하겠다고도 했다.)

In this regard, Deputy Defense Minister Lee Du-hee told reporters the previous day, "We will work to create a historic and groundbreaking turning point where FOC verification and the decision on the (OPCON) recovery timing are made at the SCM." (이와 관련, 이두희 국방부 차관은 전날 기자들과 만나 “SCM에서 FOC 검증과 (전작권) 회복 시기 결정이 되는 역사적, 획기적 전환점을 만들기 위해 노력해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

A senior defense ministry official said, "FOC verification will be conducted through the (ROK-US combined) exercise this year, and the results will be reported to the SCM," adding, "Because the tasks (for OPCON transition) are being continuously assessed, such assessments will also take place during this UFS exercise." (국방부 고위 관계자는 “FOC 검증은 금년에 (한미연합) 연습을 통해 하고 SCM에 결과 보고가 이뤄진다”며 “(전작권 전환을 위한) 과제는 지속해서 평가되고 있기 때문에 이번 UFS 연습 때도 그런 평가가 이뤄진다”고 했다.)

The government has been pushing a plan to report the results of the FOC verification of the future Combined Forces Command to the SCM this fall, and upon approval by the ROK and US defense ministers, recommend to the military commanders-in-chief of both countries a target year for OPCON transition (the so-called "X-year"). (정부는 미래연합사 FOC 검증 결과를 올 가을 SCM에 보고하고 한미 국방장관이 이를 승인하면서 양국 군 통수권자에게 전작권 전환 목표 연도(이른바 ‘X연도’)를 건의하는 구상을 추진해 왔다.)

The conditions required for OPCON transition are: ▲ military capabilities necessary to lead combined defense, ▲ the alliance's comprehensive capability to respond to North Korean nuclear and missile threats, and ▲ a security environment on the Korean Peninsula and in the region that is conducive to a stable OPCON transition. (전작권 전환에 필요한 조건은 ▲ 연합 방위 주도를 위해 필요한 군사적 능력 ▲ 동맹의 포괄적인 북한 핵·미사일 위협 대응 능력 ▲ 안정적인 전작권 전환에 부합하는 한반도 및 역내 안보 환경 등 3가지다.)

A senior defense ministry official said, "Dialogue with the US regarding OPCON is underway through various channels," and added, "We believe that a decision on the 'X-year' will be possible at this SCM." (국방부 고위 관계자는 “전작권 관련해 (미국과) 다양한 채널을 통해 대화가 이뤄지고 있다”며 “이번 SCM 때 ‘X연도’ 결정이 가능하다고 보고 있다”고 했다.)

The permanent establishment of the Combined Component Commands will also continue to be pursued. This year, the goal is to complete the permanent establishment of the Combined Special Operations Component Command, and next year, to complete the last remaining one, the Combined Military Information Support Operations Component Command, as well. (연합구성군사령부의 상설화도 지속 추진한다. 올해는 연합특수작전구성군사령부(연특사) 상설화를 완료하고, 내년에는 마지막으로 남은 연합군사정보지원작전구성군사령부(연정사)까지 상설화한다는 목표다.)

The Ministry of National Defense also said it will swiftly push forward related tasks, including the enactment of a special law within the year, to build nuclear-powered submarines. It also plans to establish the legal and institutional foundation for full-scale project implementation by next year. In addition, it said it will expand and supplement its independent deterrence capabilities by bolstering key forces, such as expanding high-power missiles and the deployment of the Korean fighter jet KF-21. (국방부는 또 핵추진잠수함(핵잠) 건조를 위해 연내 특별법 제정 등 관련 과업을 속도감 있게 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 이어 내년까지 본격적 사업 추진을 위한 법적·제도적 기반을 구축하려는 계획이다. 또 고위력 미사일 확충과 한국형 전투기 KF-21 전력화 등 핵심 전력 보강을 통해 독자적인 억제 능력을 확장·보완하겠다고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry of National Defense also plans to gradually raise officer salaries to the level of comparable mid-sized companies in similar job categories and career levels to secure outstanding talent. Specifically, the goal is to raise pay by 2029 to 40 million won annually for a first-class sergeant (Hasa) at pay grade 1, 50 million won for a staff sergeant (Jungsa), and 72 million won for a sergeant first class (Sangsa). (국방부는 우수 인력 확보를 위해 간부 연봉을 유사 직군·경력 중견기업 수준으로 단계적으로 인상하는 계획도 추진한다. 구체적으로 2029년까지 하사 1호봉 연 4000만원, 중사 5000만원, 상사 7200만원 수준까지 인상하겠다는 목표다.)

In addition, it emphasized that it will finalize the site for the relocation of the Gwangju military airfield, where the Honam region semiconductor cluster will be established, within the year to swiftly support the government's mega project. Currently, Muan County has been selected as the preliminary candidate site for the relocation of the Gwangju military airfield. (이 밖에 호남권 반도체 클러스터가 들어설 광주 군공항 최종 이전 부지를 연내 확정해 정부의 메가 프로젝트 사업을 속도감 있게 지원하겠다고 강조했다. 현재 무안군이 광주 군 공항 예비 이전 후보지로 선정된 상태다.)

item.title: People Power Party on Starbucks Raid: "Is the Police the Regime's Lapdog?" and "The Prelude to a Chinese-Style Police State" (野, 스타벅스 압색에 “경찰, 정권의 충견인가” “중국식 공안 국가의 서막”)
item.description:
People Power Party on Starbucks Raid: "Is the Police the Regime's Lapdog?" and "The Prelude to a Chinese-Style Police State" (野, 스타벅스 압색에 “경찰, 정권의 충견인가” “중국식 공안 국가의 서막”)

The People Power Party on the 5th criticized the police's raid on Starbucks Korea's headquarters in connection with suspicions of insulting the May 18 Democratization Movement, saying it was "an admission by the police that they are the regime's lapdogs" and "the prelude to a Chinese-style police state." (국민의힘은 5일 경찰이 5·18을 모욕했다는 의혹과 관련, 스타벅스 코리아 본사를 압수수색한 것에 대해 “경찰이 정권의 충견임을 자인한 것” “중국식 공안 국가의 서막”이라고 비판했다.)

Acting leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook that day regarding the raid on Starbucks headquarters, "The moment the Lee Jae-myung regime seized absolute power, they launched a 'repayment investigation' on their own." Jang added, "Civic groups have also filed complaints against President Lee Jae-myung and the ministers. If they're going to conduct a proper investigation, shouldn't they investigate all of them too? In the end, the police have admitted themselves that they are the regime's lapdogs." He continued, "They're determined to deprive us even of the 'freedom of a cup of coffee.' A regime that tries to strip away the people's freedom will surely have its power stripped away in return." (장동혁 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 스타벅스 본사 압수수색에 대해 “이재명 정권이 절대 권력을 쥐여주자마자, 알아서 ‘보은 수사’에 나선 것”이라고 했다. 장 대표는 “시민단체는 이재명 대통령과 장관들도 고발했다. 제대로 수사를 할 거면 이들도 다 같이 수사해야 하는 것 아니냐”며 “결국 경찰 스스로 정권의 충견임을 자인한 것”이라고 했다. 이어 “‘커피 한 잔의 자유’까지 기어이 박탈하려 한다”며 “국민의 자유를 박탈하려는 정권은 그 권력을 반드시 박탈당할 것”이라고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmaker Joo Jin-woo called it "the signal flare heralding the prelude to a Chinese-style police state" and said, "The full responsibility lies with President Lee Jae-myung." Joo stated, "The police's kowtowing to power has reached its peak. Does a single word from the president automatically trigger a raid?" He added, "The police must not act as the henchmen of those in power's politics of fear." He also asked, "While investigations the public truly needs are swept under the rug, are investigations that curry favor with political power being carried out excessively? With the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority, even the minimal check-and-balance mechanism has disappeared." (국민의힘 주진우 의원은 “중국식 공안 국가의 서막을 알리는 신호탄”이라며 “그 책임은 온전히 이재명 대통령에게 있다”고 했다. 주 의원은 “경찰의 권력 눈치보기가 극에 달했다. 대통령이 한마디 하면 무조건 압수수색인가”라며 “경찰이 권력자 공포 정치의 앞잡이 노릇을 해서는 안 된다”고 했다. 또 “국민에게 꼭 필요한 수사는 무마하면서 정치권력에 줄 서는 수사는 과잉으로 이루어지느냐”며 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지로 최소한의 견제 장치도 없어졌다”고 했다.)

The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Public Crime Investigation Unit announced that it had sent investigators to Starbucks Korea's headquarters in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, starting around 8:50 a.m. that day to conduct a raid. Earlier, Starbucks had sparked controversy by running a promotional advertisement for tumbler sales on May 18, the anniversary of the May 18 Democratization Movement, using phrases such as "Tank Day" and "Thud on the desk!" Civic groups filed complaints with the police against Shinsegae Chairman Chung Yong-jin and others on charges of insult and defamation. (서울경찰청 공공범죄수사대는 이날 오전 8시 50분쯤부터 서울 강남구 스타벅스코리아 본사 등에 수사관을 보내 압수수색을 진행하고 있다고 밝혔다. 앞서 스타벅스는 5·18 민주화운동 기념일인 지난 5월 18일 텀블러 판매 광고를 진행하며 ‘탱크데이’ ‘책상에 탁!’ 등의 표현을 사용해 논란이 됐다. 시민단체들은 정용진 신세계 회장 등을 모욕, 명예훼손 등 혐의로 경찰에 고소·고발했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil "I Will Pursue Impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-de... Refusing to Appoint Justices Is Dereliction of Duty" (송영길 “조희대 대법원장 탄핵 추진하겠다...대법관 임명 거부는 직무유기”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil "I Will Pursue Impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-de... Refusing to Appoint Justices Is Dereliction of Duty" (송영길 “조희대 대법원장 탄핵 추진하겠다...대법관 임명 거부는 직무유기”)

Song Young-gil, a candidate in the Democratic Party of Korea's August 17 party leadership election, said on the 5th, "I will pursue the impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice Jo Hee-de, who engages in unconstitutional acts and illegalities." (더불어민주당 8·17 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길 후보는 “위헌 행위와 불법을 일삼는 조희대 대법원장 탄핵을 추진하겠다”고 5일 밝혔다.)

At a press conference at the National Assembly that day, Candidate Song said, "Unconstitutional judicial power that seeks to lord over the people must surely face judgment," adding these remarks. (송 후보는 이날 국회 기자회견에서 “국민 위에 군림하려는 위헌적 사법 권력은 반드시 심판받아야 한다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

Candidate Song cited three grounds for impeaching Chief Justice Jo: refusal to appoint Supreme Court justices, complicity in martial law, and illegal interference in the presidential election. "Former Supreme Court Justice Noh Tae-ak retired in March. Yet Chief Justice Jo has not recommended a single nominee to this day, six months later," Song said, calling it "unprecedented in constitutional history." Song added, "Under the Constitution, recommendation is not merely a power of the Chief Justice but a duty. Refusing that duty is clear dereliction," and said, "Chief Justice Jo must face the judgment of the law." (송 후보는 조 대법원장 탄핵 사유로 대법관 임명 거부·계엄 동조·불법 대선 개입 등 세 가지를 들었다. 송 후보는 “노태악 전 대법관이 3월 퇴임했다. 그런데 조 대법원장은 반년이 지난 오늘까지 단 한 명도 (임명) 제청하지 않고 있다”면서 “헌정사에 전례가 없는 일”이라고 했다. 송 후보는 “헌법상 제청은 대법원장의 권한이기 이전에 의무다. 의무의 거부는 명백한 직무 유기”라면서 “조 대법원장은 법의 심판을 받아야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the December 3 martial law declaration, Song said, "The next day, Chief Justice Jo's first words were, 'We need to see what procedures the martial law went through.' Instead of pointing out the illegality of martial law, he was calculating the judiciary's position after martial law. Silence is complicity." (12·3 비상계엄과 관련해선 “(계엄) 다음 날 조 대법원장의 첫마디는 ‘계엄이 어떤 절차를 거쳤는지 지켜봐야 한다’였다”면서 “계엄의 위법을 지적하는 대신, 계엄 이후의 사법부를 계산하고 있었던 것이다. 침묵은 곧 동조”라고 했다.)

On the Supreme Court's decision to remand President Lee Jae-myung's case for retrial with a guilty finding ahead of last year's presidential election, Song said, "The purpose was singular: to bring down Lee Jae-myung, the leading presidential candidate," calling it "election interference under the guise of justice." (송 후보는 대법원이 지난해 대선을 앞두고 이재명 대통령 사건을 유죄 취지로 파기환송한 데 대해선 “목적은 단 하나였다. 유력 대선 후보 이재명을 낙마시키는 것”이라면서 “사법의 이름을 빌린 선거 개입”이라고 했다.)

Song said, "The essence running through these three matters is the judicial power's violation of the constitutional order." He added, "Along with a competence dispute adjudication over the infringement of the National Assembly's authority and a criminal complaint for dereliction of duty, I will pursue an impeachment motion. I will suspend Jo Hee-de from his duties, complete the composition of constitutional institutions, and restore the constitutional order." (송 후보는 “이 세 가지를 관통하는 본질은 사법 권력의 헌정 질서 유린”이라고 했다. 또 “국회 권한 침해에 대한 권한쟁의심판, 직무 유기 고발과 함께 탄핵소추를 추진하겠다”면서 “조희대의 직무를 정지시키고, 헌법기관 구성을 완성해 헌정 질서를 회복하겠다”라고 했다.)

Candidate Kim Min-seok, also running in the party leadership election, mentioned the impeachment of Chief Justice Jo on the 30th of last month. At the time, Kim wrote on X (formerly Twitter), "Chief Justice Jo Hee-de's dereliction of duty has gone too far," adding, "If he does not immediately recommend a successor, can he avoid impeachment in defense of the constitutional order?" (당대표 선거에 출마한 김민석 후보도 지난달 30일 조 대법원장 탄핵을 언급했다. 당시 김 후보는 X(옛 트위터)에 “조희대 대법원장의 직무 유기가 도를 넘었다”면서 “후임 제청을 즉각 하지 않고 헌정 수호 차원의 탄핵을 피할 수 있겠나”라는 글을 남겼다.)

item.title: President Lee Criticizes "Unloaded Rifle Guard Duty" - "With 66 Trillion Won Defense Budget, It's Unacceptable to Have No Arrows" (李대통령 ‘빈총 경계’에 “66조 국방비 들여놓고 화살 없으면 안 될 일”)
item.description:
President Lee Criticizes "Unloaded Rifle Guard Duty" - "With 66 Trillion Won Defense Budget, It's Unacceptable to Have No Arrows" (李대통령 ‘빈총 경계’에 “66조 국방비 들여놓고 화살 없으면 안 될 일”)

At the joint ministry report on foreign affairs, unification, defense, and veterans affairs held on the 5th, President Lee Jae-myung pointed out the recent issue of "unloaded rifle (no live ammunition loaded) guard duty" at military guard posts. President Lee remarked, "If we keep retreating step by step, thinking 'surely nothing will happen,' we may eventually reach a point where there isn't a single arrow left in the arrow warehouse," and ordered the establishment of strict military discipline. (이재명 대통령이 5일 열린 외교·통일·국방·보훈부 합동 업무 보고에서 최근 군 경계 근무 현장의 ‘빈총(실탄 미장전) 경계’ 문제를 지적했다. 이 대통령은 “설마 무슨 일이 있겠어라며 하나씩 후퇴하다 보면 나중에는 화살 창고에 화살이 한 개도 없는 상황이 올 수 있다”며 엄정한 군기 확립을 주문했다.)

◇"From Mulberry to Bamboo, to Reed... 'Unloaded Rifle Guard Duty' Is Exactly That Trend" (◇“뽕나무에서 대나무, 갈대로… ‘빈총 경계’가 딱 그 경향”)

In his opening remarks that day, President Lee cited an old tale warning against complacency in military logistics management. President Lee said, "In the old days, when a nation was first founded, they stored the best-performing mulberry wood arrows. But since they cost too much, they switched to bamboo arrows, and later, since they looked the same, they switched to reed arrows." He continued, "Then one day a war broke out, and when they went to actually shoot, they found that even the reeds hadn't been made, leaving the warehouse empty." (이 대통령은 이날 모두 발언에서 과거 군수 관리의 안일함을 경고하는 옛이야기를 인용했다. 이 대통령은 “옛날 나라를 만들고 처음에는 성능이 가장 좋은 뽕나무 화살을 보관하다가, 돈이 많이 드니 대나무 화살로 바꾸고, 나중에는 보기에 똑같으니 갈대 화살로 바꿨다”며 “어느 날 전쟁이 딱 벌어져 진짜 쏠라고 보니까 그 갈대조차 안 만들어 창고가 비어 있더라는 이야기가 있다”고 말을 꺼냈다.)

President Lee then said, "Recently, there's been controversy over guard duty without loading ammunition. That is precisely part of this trend of going from mulberry to bamboo, and from bamboo to reed." He added, "'Surely nothing will happen. Rather than risking an accidental incident while loading live ammunition, let's just leave it unloaded—we can quickly insert it and respond if needed.' There's a high possibility such thinking is at play. In everyday life, that reasoning isn't wrong. But national defense is different." (이어 이 대통령은 “최근에 무슨 삽탄 안 하고 경계 근무하다가 논란이 되고 있던데, 그게 딱 뽕나무에서 대나무로, 대나무에서 갈대로 가는 경향의 일부”라며 “‘설마 무슨 일이 있겠어. 혹시 삽탄하고 있다가 실수로 무슨 사고 나는 것보다 차라리 빼놓자, 금방 꽂아서 대응하면 되지’ 이런 생각이 있을 가능성이 많다. 사실 일상적인 삶에서는 그 생각이 틀리지 않는다. 그렇지만 국방은 아니다”고 했다.)

Behind President Lee's use of this analogy lies the reality of "unloaded rifle guard duty" at frontline guard units, which was reported through this newspaper's coverage. At the time, it was revealed that some units, under the pretext of preventing safety accidents such as accidental firearm discharges, deployed personnel for anti-infiltration and guard operations without loading live ammunition or with magazines removed—sparking controversy over lax military discipline. (이 대통령이 이런 비유를 꺼낸 배경에는 본지 보도를 통해 알려진 최전방 경계 부대의 ‘빈총 경계 근무’ 실태가 자리 잡고 있다. 당시 일부 부대에서 총기 오발 등 안전 사고를 막는다는 명목으로 대간첩·경계 작전 시 실탄을 장전하지 않거나 탄창을 뺀 채 근무에 투입된 사실이 밝혀져 군기 해이 논란이 일었다.)

◇"If We Retreat One by One, the Day Will Come When the Arrow Warehouse Is Empty" (◇“하나씩 후퇴하면 화살 창고 비는 날 온다”)

President Lee warned that if such complacency accumulates, it could trigger a serious crisis for national security as a whole. President Lee pointed out, "If we think that way, we might also say about spending nearly 66 trillion won annually on defense, 'Surely war won't break out—why waste the money?' But that doesn't make sense, does it?" He added, "On the issue of military discipline, if we keep retreating one step at a time, we could eventually reach a situation where there isn't a single arrow left in the arrow warehouse." He continued, "Overall, it's maintained very well, but the public sentiment is that they'd like even those small gaps to be eliminated." (이 대통령은 이러한 안일함이 쌓일 경우 국가 안보 전체에 심각한 위기를 부를 수 있다고 경고했다. 이 대통령은 “그런 식으로 생각하면 연간 국방비 66조 가깝게 지출하는 걸 ‘설마 전쟁 나겠어, 아깝게 왜 해’라고 할 수도 있는데, 그건 말이 안 되지 않느냐”며 “군기 문제는 거의 하나씩 하나씩 후퇴하면 나중에는 화살 창고에 화살이 한 개도 없는 상황이 올 수도 있다”고 지적했다. 이어 “전체적으로는 매우 훌륭하게 잘 유지되고 있지만, 그 작은 틈새도 없으면 좋겠다는 게 국민들의 여론”이라고 했다.)

In response, Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek stated, "I believe this is something that must never happen. We will ensure full readiness," and pledged measures to establish field guard posture and military discipline. (이에 대해 안규백 국방부 장관은 “있을 수 없는 일이라고 생각한다. 만전을 기하겠다”며 현장 경계 태세 및 군기 확립 조치를 약속했다.)

◇"It's Inconceivable for the Armed Forces Not to Be Under the Commander-in-Chief's Command" (◇“국군이 군통수권자 지휘 안 받는 건 있을 수 없는 일”)

Meanwhile, President Lee said, "It is inconceivable for the armed forces not to be under the command of the defense minister, who receives orders from the president as the commander-in-chief. Normalizing this is an important task we must undertake." He added, "Of course, military command authority, which is part of sovereignty, must also be exercised on our own." This is interpreted as reaffirming his existing position that wartime operational control (OPCON) should be transferred back to the South Korean military within the Lee Jae-myung administration's term. (한편 이 대통령은 “국군이 군 통수권자인 대통령의 명령을 받는 국방부 장관의 지휘를 받지 않는 것은 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 “이 정상화도 우리가 해야 할 중요한 과제”라며 “당연히 주권의 일부인 군 지휘권도 스스로 행사해야 한다”고 했다. 이는 전시작전통제권(전작권)을 한국군으로 이재명 정부 임기 내에 전환해야 한다는 기존 입장을 강조한 것으로 풀이된다.)

President Lee stated, "If a nation cannot defend itself with its own strength, it is disqualified as a state," and added, "Self-reliant defense—defending ourselves with our own strength without any external help—is our greatest task." (이 대통령은 “하나의 국가가 스스로를 힘으로 지키지 못한다면 결격”이라며 “어떤 외부의 도움도 없이 우리 스스로의 힘으로 지켜나가는 자주국방은 우리의 가장 큰 과제”라고 했다.)

item.title: Chung Dong-young: "We Must Stop Using 'Main Enemy' Terminology... 'Threat' Is an Appropriate Substitute" (정동영 “주적 표현 멈춰야...대체 용어로 ‘위협’이 적절”)
item.description:
Chung Dong-young: "We Must Stop Using 'Main Enemy' Terminology... 'Threat' Is an Appropriate Substitute" (정동영 “주적 표현 멈춰야...대체 용어로 ‘위협’이 적절”)

Unification Minister Chung Dong-young announced on the 5th during a presidential work report that he would push for measures to replace the term "main enemy" (jujeok) used in reference to North Korea. Minister Chung stated that "threat" is an appropriate substitute term for "main enemy." (정동영 통일부 장관은 5일 대통령 업무보고에서 북한에 대한 ‘주적’ 용어를 대체하는 방안을 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 정 장관은 주적을 대체하는 용어로 “위협이 적절하다”고 했다.)

During the second-half ministerial work plan report held at the Blue House that morning, Minister Chung said, "Starting with calling each other by our names as a first step, we must stop using language of confrontation and hatred toward each other, such as 'main enemy.'" (정 장관은 이날 오전 청와대에서 진행된 하반기 부처 업무계획 보고에서 “서로 이름을 불러주는 것을 첫걸음으로, 주적 등 서로에 대한 대결과 혐오의 언어는 멈춰야 한다”고 했다.)

In a media pre-briefing held the previous day, the 4th, Minister Chung also said, "For genuine mutual respect, expressions like 'main enemy' need to be discontinued," adding, "We will engage in constructive discussions to achieve this." Minister Chung stated, "It is not right to call (North Korea) the 'main enemy' while pursuing peaceful coexistence," and "I believe the term 'threat,' which was used by the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations, is appropriate." He further said, "The term 'enemy' used by the Yoon Suk-yeol administration is inappropriate," and "The chilling situation in which the commander-in-chief of the military stepped forward to designate (North Korea) as the 'main enemy' must be brought to an end." <<> Minister Chung's push to replace the "main enemy" term comes ahead of the publication of the "2026 Defense White Paper," the first defense white paper after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration at the end of this year. The existing "2022 Defense White Paper" identifies "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military as our enemy." The Ministry of National Defense has stated it will review what to do with this expression after gathering various opinions. Regarding the removal of the "main enemy" term from the Defense White Paper, Minister Chung said, "The Ministry of National Defense is stubborn," and "Each ministry has its own reason for existing. The reason for the Unification Ministry's existence, the Foreign Ministry's existence, and the Defense Ministry's existence are all different, and the function to integrate and coordinate these lies with the NSC, where this has already been discussed and will continue to be discussed." <<> In its work report that day, the Unification Ministry reported its key tasks for the second half of the year, including restoring the September 19 military agreement to build inter-Korean trust, commencing discussions to transition the armistice regime into a peace regime, and formulating a strategy for the "prior freeze" of North Korea's nuclear program. Regarding the "prior freeze" strategy, Minister Chung said, "The complete, verifiable, and irreversible denuclearization (CVID) framework that formed one pillar over the past 25 years has already collapsed," and "At this point, merely repeating the old call for 'denuclearization first' does not help change reality, and there is no disagreement among government ministries on the 'prior freeze' approach, which is a step-by-step strategy." <<> The Unification Ministry plans to concentrate its efforts through the UN General Assembly in September and the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, China, in November to secure momentum for four-party dialogue and make all-out efforts to draw in a North Korea-U.S. summit. Minister Chung said, "As a hope, I believe that if we can hold an inter-Korean summit at least in the first half of the term, substantive restoration and progress in inter-Korean relations will be possible," adding, "I have a sense of urgency that we need to create an important turning point through the President's Liberation Day address on August 15." He also said he felt the government had been passive during the APEC summit last November and President Trump's visit to China in May, and that the government is actively considering participating in the Eastern Economic Forum to be held in Russia this September. <<> The Unification Ministry also plans to resume the restoration project for the southern section of the Gyeongwon Line (Baengmagoji to Woljeong-ri), which began under the Park Geun-hye administration but was suspended for the past 10 years, with completion targeted by 2029. Minister Chung said, "This is to prepare in advance so that, once inter-Korean relations are restored, we can connect the 17km stretch from Woljeong-ri to Pyeonggang and travel directly from Yongsan to Wonsan." Wonsan is where the Wonsan-Kalma coastal tourist district, which North Korea opened in July last year with an eye toward attracting large numbers of foreign tourists, is located. <<> As one of the Unification Ministry's achievements in the first half of this year, Minister Chung highlighted obtaining sanctions exemptions from the UN Security Council in May for 166 types of diagnostic, surgical, and treatment equipment worth 10 billion won, to be provided through the "International Health and Medical Foundation," with cooperation with local hospitals built under Chairman Kim Jong-un's flagship "Regional Development 20x10" policy in mind. Minister Chung said, "Everything is currently severed and blocked, but this was prepared in case inter-Korean relations open a path and we pursue cooperation projects in the future." (정 장관은 전날인 4일 진행한 언론 사전 브리핑에서도 “진정한 상호존중을 위해서는 주적과 같은 표현은 멈출 필요가 있다”며 “이를 위한 건설적 논의를 해나가겠다”고 했다. 정 장관은 “(북한과) 평화공존을 추구하면서 주적이라고 하는 건 옳지 않다”며 “노무현·문재인 정부가 사용했던 ‘위협’이라는 표현이 적절하다고 생각한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “윤석열 정부에서 썼던 ‘적’이라는 표현은 부적절하다”며 “군 통수권자가 나서서 ‘주적’이라고 규정한 섬뜩한 상황은 청산해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee to Chair Second Real Estate Policy Review Meeting on the 7th (李대통령, 7일 부동산 정책 점검 2차 회의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will privately chair the second real estate policy review meeting at 2 PM on the 7th. (이재명 대통령이 7일 오후 2시 부동산 정책 점검 2차 회의를 비공개로 주재한다.)

Kang Yu-jung, the Blue House senior press secretary, announced on the 5th through a notice, "President Lee will privately chair the second real estate policy review meeting at 2 PM on the 7th, as instructed during the real estate and stock market review meeting held on the 3rd." This is a follow-up to the "Real Estate and Stock Market Review Meeting" that lasted 7 hours and 30 minutes on the day he returned from his U.S. and South American tour on the 3rd. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 5일 공지를 통해 “이 대통령은 지난 3일 부동산 및 주식시장 점검 회의에서 지시했던 부동산 정책 점검 2차 회의를 7일 오후 2시에 비공개로 주재할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 지난 3일 미국·남미 순방에서 귀국한 당일 7시간 30분 동안 진행한 ‘부동산 및 주식시장 점검 회의’의 후속 회의다.)

At this meeting, the review results from relevant ministries on the housing supply expansion measures requested by President Lee at the previous meeting are expected to be reported in depth. After outlining the broad direction at the first meeting, the second meeting is expected to examine concrete implementation plans, including supply volumes, target sites, streamlining of administrative procedures, and financial and fiscal support. (이번 회의에서는 이 대통령이 지난 회의에서 주문한 주택 공급 확대 방안에 대한 관계 부처의 검토 결과가 집중적으로 보고될 전망이다. 첫 회의에서 큰 방향을 제시한 데 이어 두 번째 회의에서는 공급 물량과 대상 부지, 행정 절차 단축, 금융·재정 지원 등 구체적인 실행 계획을 점검할 것으로 보인다.)

At the meeting held on the 3rd, which lasted 7 hours and 30 minutes, President Lee pointed out that the sluggish housing supply since 2022 has led to a "supply cliff," emphasizing that not only the volume of supply but also the speed is critical. He also ordered a broad review of all available measures, including securing as much usable supply as possible and mobilizing administrative actions, financial and fiscal support, and regulatory easing. (이 대통령은 지난 3일 7시간 30분 동안 진행된 회의에서 2022년 이후 지속된 주택 공급 부진이 ‘공급 절벽’으로 이어졌다고 지적하며 공급 물량뿐 아니라 속도가 중요하다고 강조했다. 가용한 공급 물량을 최대한 확보하고 행정 조치와 금융·재정 지원, 규제 완화 등 동원할 수 있는 방안을 폭넓게 검토하라는 지시도 내렸다.)

The government began consultations among relevant ministries and gathering market opinions immediately after the first meeting. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and financial authorities are known to have reviewed regulations and financial difficulties hindering housing supply and narrowed down measures that could produce supply effects in the short term. (정부는 첫 회의 직후 관계 부처 협의와 시장 의견 수렴에 착수했다. 국토교통부와 금융 당국 등은 주택 공급을 가로막는 규제와 금융 애로 사항을 점검하고, 단기간에 공급 효과를 낼 수 있는 방안을 추려온 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: "Never Held Accountable for the Military Coup"... Lee Pushes for Unification of Military Academies (“육사 쿠데타 책임 물은적 없어”... 사관학교 통합에 힘실은 李)
item.description:
"Never Held Accountable for the Military Coup"... Lee Pushes for Unification of Military Academies (“육사 쿠데타 책임 물은적 없어”... 사관학교 통합에 힘실은 李)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 5th regarding the issue of unifying the nation's military academies, "How many military coups has South Korea had so far?" and "They all happened in the Army—weren't those the doing of Korea Military Academy graduates?" The President continued, "Has anyone ever been held accountable for that?" adding, "The center of those three coups was the KMA, yet not once were they held responsible. Couldn't they do it again in the future?" (이재명 대통령은 5일 군(軍) 사관학교 통합 문제와 관련해 “지금까지 대한민국의 군사 쿠데타가 몇 번 있었느냐”며 “다 육군에서 벌어진 일이고, 육사 출신들이 한 일 아닌가”라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “거기에 대해 책임을 물은 일이 있느냐”며 “쿠데타를 무려 세 번이나 했던 중심이 육사인데 한 번도 책임을 묻지 않았다. 앞으로 또 할 수 있지 않나”라고 했다.)

During a defense ministry briefing held at the presidential office that day, President Lee said, "Wouldn't unification reduce that possibility?" He made this remark in response to opposition to merging the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, citing "military coups" as a rebuttal. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 이뤄진 국방부 업무 보고에서 “통합을 하면 이런 가능성이 좀 줄어들지 않겠나”라고 했다. 육군·해군·공군 사관학교 통합에 반대 목소리가 나오는 데 대해 ‘군사 쿠데타’를 언급하며 반박한 것이다.)

Regarding the December 3 martial law crisis of 2024, President Lee also said, "South Korea has been democratized and has become an advanced nation that the whole world looks to, but who would have thought Army generals would collude to stage a military praetorian coup?" He added, "Shouldn't we structurally make it absolutely impossible for such a coup to happen in the future?" (이 대통령은 지난 2024년 벌어진 12·3 비상 계엄 사태에 대해서도 “대한민국이 민주화됐고 전 세계가 바라보는 선진국이 됐는데 육군 장성들이 동조해 군사 친위 쿠데타를 할 것으로 누가 생각이나 했겠느냐”며 “앞으로 구조적으로 절대로 (쿠데타를) 못 하게 해야 될 것 아니냐”고 했다.)

The President stated, "This is not something to brush aside as a past event that was suppressed," and "If it had succeeded, wouldn't all Army captains have been watching us like in the old days? Wouldn't non-commissioned officers have gone into newsrooms, crossed out article drafts, and censored the internet?" (이 대통령은 “지난 일이고 진압이 됐다고 적당히 넘어갈 일이 아니다”라며 “성공했다면 옛날처럼 육군 대위들이 다 감시하지 않았겠나. 언론사들 부사관들이 들어가서 (기사 원고를) 찍찍 그어가며 인터넷 검열을 하지 않았겠나”라고도 했다.)

President Lee said, "Is it acceptable to develop the military separately by branch, let one specific branch overwhelmingly dominate the armed forces over a very long period, occasionally stage a coup that tears the country apart, and then walk away without any accountability?" (이 대통령은 “군별로 따로 떼어서 군을 육성하고, 아주 장기간 특정 군종이 군대를 압도적으로 장악하고, 가끔 쿠데타를 일으켜 나라를 절단 내고 난 다음 아무런 책임을 안 지면 되겠나”라고 했다.)

He continued, "The vast majority of soldiers are loyal to the nation and fulfilling their calling as service members, but a few have committed these unforgivable acts," adding, "Shouldn't we eliminate the conditions for that?" (이어 “대다수의 장병은 국가에 충성하며 군인의 소명을 다하고 있는데 일부가 이런 용서 못 할 짓을 벌인다”며 “그런 소지를 없애야 하는 것 아닌가”라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Advises Chung, Who Wanted to Call North Korea "Joseon," That "Every Expression Becomes a Target of Political Strife... Must Be Cautious" (李, 北을 ‘조선’으로 부르자던 鄭에 “표현 하나하나 정쟁 대상...신중해야” 당부)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 5th at the second-half departmental work plan briefing held at the Cheongwadae State Guest House that during the pursuit of peace and coexistence policies, "there are aspects being exploited tactically and politically" and told Unification Minister Chung Dong-young, "Unintentionally, a single term or a single expression becomes a target of political strife, so I feel we need to be even more cautious." (이재명 대통령은 5일 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 하반기 부처 업무계획 보고에서 정동영 통일부 장관에게 평화·공존 정책 추진과정에서 “정략적·정치적으로 악용되는 측면들이 있다”며 “본의 아니게 용어 하나, 표현 하나 가지고 정쟁의 대상이 되고 하니까 더욱 신중해야 되겠다는 생각은 든다”고 했다.)

At the Unification Ministry's work report that day, President Lee said, "It's difficult, but we must continue our policies of peace and coexistence," adding, "But as I mentioned earlier, there are aspects of this being exploited tactically and politically. So I think we need to be very careful." President Lee also said, "The Unification Ministry must be having a hard time these days. It must feel like shouting into the void. But what can we do?" He continued, "For example, there's no response (from North Korea to our policies), and occasionally there is some response, but in any case, (North Korea) is a neighbor we can never separate from, and they're right there beside us," adding, "(The two Koreas) have fought a war, share blood ties, and the relationship has fluctuated between good and bad, but these days it's in a very bad state." (이 대통령은 이날 통일부 업무보고에서 “힘들긴 하지만 우리가 평화와 공존의 정책을 계속해가야 되겠다”며 “그런데 이게 역시 아까 말씀드렸던 것처럼 정략적으로 정치적으로 악용되는 측면들이 있다. 그래서 많이 조심하여야 될 것 같다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “통일부는 요새 힘들죠”라며 “메아리 없는 함성을 지르는 느낌 같을거다. 그런데 어떡하겠어요”라며 “예를 들면 뭐 (북한이 우리 정책에) 반응도 없고 가끔씩은 반응도 생기긴 하지만 어쨌든 (북한은) 우리가 결코 떨어질 수 없는 불가피한 이웃이라고 하기도 그렇고 하여튼 (북한) 옆에 있는 것 아닌가”라면서 “(남북은) 전쟁도 치렀고 혈육의 관계이기도 하고 관계가 좋았다 나빴다 하는데 요즘 매우 나쁜 상태”라고 했다.)

President Lee said, "It's the same with personal relationships, but intergovernmental relations also have accumulated baggage from the past. It's karma." He added, "Because we've spent so much time being overly hostile, dismissive, and confrontational, it's hard for the relationship to improve easily. But that doesn't mean we should take the easiest path, where you go your way and I go mine. Politically speaking, confrontation is often advantageous." He continued, "Don't people sometimes take a confrontational stance deliberately to consolidate internal unity? But in the end, that's bad for the people. It's harmful to the national community. So although it's difficult, we must continue our policies of peace and coexistence." (이 대통령은 “사람과의 관계도 그렇지만 정부 간 관계도 (과거에) 쌓인 게 있는 것”이라며 “업보”라고 했다. 그러면서 “너무 적대시하고 무시하고 대결적으로 좀 많은 오랜 시간을 살아왔기 때문에 (관계가) 쉽게 좋아지기가 어렵다”며 “그런데 그렇다고 해서 우리가 제일 편한 길, 너는 네가 갈 길 가고 나는 내가 갈 길 가고, 또 정무적으로 보면 사실은 대결하는 게 도움이 되는 경우가 많다”고 했다. 이어 “내부 단속(결속)을 위해서 일부러 대결적인 입장을 취하기도 하지 않나”라며 “그런데 그건 결국 국민들한테는 나쁘다. 국가 공동체에게는 해악”이라면서 “그래서 힘들긴 하지만 우리가 평화와 공존의 정책을 계속해 나가야 되겠다”고 했다.)

President Lee also said that day, "In the security sector and inter-Korean relations, when you try to do things properly with good intentions, people seize on it to attack, and in the end, the situation gets worse." He said, "For example, how we officially refer to the two Koreas is a matter of debate. I'm sure you do it with good intentions and firm belief that it's for improving relations, but I think there was a controversy about this recently too. You mentioned it once and were fiercely attacked for it." He added, "So as I said, we have good values and ideals, but if our expressions are seized upon and dragged into political strife, it could lead to a worse situation than what we originally intended. Of course, raising contentious points does have the effect of broadening the horizon of (social discourse). But we really need to think carefully about this. It's unfortunate, but there seem to be many such issues especially in inter-Korean relations." (이 대통령은 이날 “안보분야, 남북관계 분야는 뭔가 선의를 갖고 제대로 하려고 그러면 오히려 꼬투리를 잡아갖고 공격해서 결론적으로는 더 악화된 상황이 되는 경우가 있다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “예를 들면 남북한 공식 명칭 부르는 일은 논쟁의 여지가 있는 일”이라며 “당연히 선의로 하는 일이고 관계 개선을 위한 일이라고 확신하고 하시는 것일텐데 이게 아마 얼마전에도 논쟁이 한번 됐던 것 같다. (장관이) 한번 말씀하셨다가 심하게 반격당하셨죠”라고 했다. 그러면서 “그래서 말씀드렸던것처럼 우리가 좋은 가치와 이상을 갖고 있지만 이게 뭔가 표현에 꼬투리가 잡혀서 정쟁으로 들어가면 원래 하고자 했던데서 오히려 나쁜 상황이 초래될 수도 있겠다”며 “물론 논쟁꺼리를 주장하면서 (사회적 논의의) 지평이 넓어지는 효과는 또 있다. 그런데 정말로 잘 고민해야 될 것 같다. 안타까운 일이긴 한데 이런 영역이 특히 남북관계에 많은 것 같다”고 했다.)

Minister Chung Dong-young, at a media pre-briefing the previous day, the 4th, said regarding the terminology for North Korea, "The government intends to support public discourse rather than get ahead of it," and "Calling (North Korea) Joseon is a sufficiently unfamiliar term, so I think time and process are needed for it to be accepted and absorbed by public opinion." Minister Chung, who had initially attempted to actively promote public discourse by calling North Korea "Joseon" at academic seminars and elsewhere, recently said at a press conference marking his first year in office, "Even things that would succeed won't if the government takes the lead," appearing to step back. (정동영 장관은 전날인 4일 언론 사전 브리핑에서 북한 호칭과 관련해 “정부가 앞서가기 보다는 공론화를 뒷받침해 가겠다는 것”이라며 “(북한을 조선이라 부르는 것은) 충분히 생경한 용어이기 때문에 국민 여론 속에 수용이 되고 흡수되는 시간과 과정이 필요하리라고 생각한다”고 했다. 당초 학술 세미나 등에서 북한을 ‘조선’으로 부르며 적극적 공론화를 시도했던 정 장관은 최근 취임 1년 기자 간담회에서 “정부가 나서면 될 일도 안된다”며 한발짝 물러난 듯한 발언을 했다.)

President Lee also that day ordered the Unification Ministry to respond strongly to distorted claims made by some conservative YouTubers regarding the construction of the "Northeast Asia Peace Archives," an expansion and reorganization of the existing "North Korea Materials Center." President Lee said, "Some people are saying things that are clearly contrary to the facts. They're being circulated as if they have some basis." (이 대통령은 이날 통일부에 기존 ‘북한자료센터’를 확대·개편한 ‘동북아 평화자료원’ 건설과 관련해 일부 보수 유투버들의 왜곡된 사실관계 주장에 강력한 대응을 주문하기도 했다. 이 대통령은 “일부에서 엄연히 사실과 다른 얘기를 하고 있다”며 “나름 근거가 있는 것 처럼 유포되고 있더라”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "They're saying things like, 'This normal project, one even pursued under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, is now, under the Lee Jae-myung administration, spending tens of billions of won to build a library for North Korea.' On issues like this, you shouldn't just let it pass—I'm telling you to respond forcefully to malicious distortions and manipulations that misrepresent the facts." He added, "If necessary, you need to consider legal sanctions. The (Unification Ministry) has explained a lot. I know that. Yet they're still continuing (those claims). Their firepower seems stronger than the Ministry's." (이 대통령은 “정상적인 사업, 윤석열 정부에서도 추진하던 사업조차 이재명 정부에서 북한을 돕기 위해 수백억을 들여서 북한 도서관을 짓는다 이렇게 말하더라”며 “이런 문제에 대해서는 그냥 넘어갈게 아니고 팩트(fact·사실)가 다른 악의적인 왜곡 조작에 대해서는 강력하게 대응하시라는 얘기”라고 했다. 그러면서 “필요하면 법적 제재도 가하실 필요가 있는 것 같다”며 “(통일부가) 설명을 많이 했잖아요. 제가 알고 있다. 그런데도 현재도 (그런 주장을) 계속하고 있다. 근데 화력이 통일부보다 더 세더라”고 했다.)

Some conservative YouTubers are criticizing the government's plan to build the "Northeast Asia Peace Archives," asking whether hundreds of billions of won are being spent to build a library for North Korea. The Unification Ministry plans to expand and reorganize the "North Korea Materials Center," which has operated since 1989, and build the "Northeast Asia Peace Archives" near KINTEX in Goyang City, Gyeonggi Province. The "North Korea Materials Center" is currently operating in a portion of the "National Library of Korea" in Seocho-gu, Seoul. (일부 보수 유튜버들은 정부의 ‘동북아 평화자료원’ 건설을 놓고 수백억 들여 북한도서관 짓느냐고 비난하고 있다. 통일부는 1989년부터 운영한 ‘북한자료센터’를 확대·개편해 경기 고양시 킨덱스 인근에 ‘동북아 평화자료원’을 건설하겠다는 계획이다. 현재 ‘북한자료센터’는 서울 서초구 ‘국립중앙도서관’ 내 일부 공간에서 운영되고 있다.)

In December 2024, during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, the Unification Ministry announced plans to begin construction of the "National Unification Information and Materials Center" with a total project cost of 48.4 billion won to build a standalone facility and relocate the "North Korea Materials Center," which had been operating in a portion of one floor of the National Library of Korea, and construction began. After the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, the project's scope and role expanded, and the name was changed to the "Northeast Asia Peace Archives." The government's vision is not limited to North Korean materials but to serve as a "peace archive" that exhibits, educates, researches, and documents the past 100 years of war and peace in Northeast Asia and the Korean Peninsula, while also providing various programs for local residents and citizens to use. <<>> (통일부는 윤석열 정부때인 2024년 12월 기존 국립중앙도서관 내 한 개 층 일부 공간에서 운영되던 ‘북한자료센터’를 독립 건물로 신축·이전하기 위해 총 사업비 484억 원을 들여 ‘국립통일정보자료센터’ 착공 계획을 발표하고 공사를 시작했다. 이재명 정부 출범 이후 사업 범위와 역할이 확대됐고 명칭도 ‘동북아 평화자료원’으로 바뀌었다. 정부는 북한 자료에 국한하지 않고 지난 100년 간 동북아 및 한반도의 전쟁과 평화와 관련한 역사를 전시·교육·연구·기록하는 ‘평화 아카이브’ 역할을 수행하고 지역 주민들과 시민들이 이용할 수 있는 다양한 프로그램을 제공하겠다는 구상이다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Lee Ki-in, Accused of Defaming Kim Hyun-ji, Receives No-Charge Disposition ([단독] ‘김현지 명예훼손’ 혐의 이기인, 무혐의 불송치)
item.description:
Lee Ki-in, the secretary-general of the Reform Party, who was reported by a pro-Myung organization on charges of defamation for allegedly releasing a video of Kim Hyun-ji, the senior presidential secretary for the first office, related to her past "intrusion into the Seongnam City Council" incident, has received a no-charge disposition. (김현지 청와대 제1부속실장의 과거 ‘성남시의회 난입 사건’ 영상을 공개했다는 등의 이유로 친명(親明) 조직으로부터 명예훼손 혐의로 고발당한 개혁신당 이기인 사무총장이 불송치 처분을 받았다.)

According to a comprehensive report by this newspaper on the 5th, the Anti-Corruption and Economic Crime Investigation Unit of the Gyeonggi Southern Provincial Police Agency issued a no-charge decision on the 31st of last month regarding the charges of defamation and insult against Secretary-General Lee concerning Deputy Secretary Kim. The police ruled no suspicion due to insufficient evidence on the defamation charges and no right to prosecute on the insult charges. A police official explained, "Insult is a crime that requires a formal complaint, and since no complaint was filed by the party concerned, it was concluded as having no right to prosecute." (5일 본지 취재를 종합하면 경기남부경찰청 반부패경제범죄수사대는 이 사무총장의 김 부속실장에 대한 명예훼손과 모욕 등 혐의에 대해 지난달 31일 불송치 결정을 내렸다. 경찰은 이 사무총장의 명예훼손 혐의에 대해서는 증거 불충분으로 인한 무혐의 결정을, 모욕 혐의에 대해서는 공소권 없음 결정을 내렸다. 경찰 관계자는 “모욕은 친고죄에 해당돼 당사자의 고소가 없었기 때문에 공소권 없음으로 종결된 것”이라고 설명했다.)

Previously, on October 20 of last year, Secretary-General Lee released a video showing then-lawyer Lee Jae-myung, now the President, and Deputy Secretary Kim, who was then the secretary-general of the "Seongnam Citizens' Assembly," intruding into the Seongnam City Council on March 25, 2004, and strongly protesting by pushing city officials and shouting. As a result of that incident, President Lee Jae-myung and Deputy Secretary Kim were sentenced to fines. (앞서 이 사무총장은 김 실장이 ‘성남시민모임’ 사무국장이던 2004년 3월 25일 당시 변호사였던 이재명 대통령 등과 함께 성남시의회에 난입해 시 공무원 등을 밀치거나 소리 지르며 강하게 항의하는 등의 모습이 담긴 영상을 작년 10월 20일 공개했다. 당시 사건으로 이재명 대통령과 김 실장은 벌금형을 선고받았다.)

After Secretary-General Lee released the video, the Democratic Party of Korea's Gyeonggi Innovation Council, a pro-President Lee organization, reported him to the Bundang Police Station on October 27, alleging defamation of Deputy Secretary Kim. However, the police transferred the case from the Bundang Police Station to the Anti-Corruption and Economic Crime Investigation Unit of the Gyeonggi Southern Provincial Police Agency just three days after the report. Defamation cases are typically handled by the investigation division of local police stations, but this case was specially transferred to a higher authority and assigned to a special and public security investigation unit, which sparked controversy at the time. (이 사무총장의 영상 공개 이후 이 대통령 친위 조직인 더민주경기혁신회의는 10월 27일 김 실장의 명예를 훼손했다며 이 총장을 경기 분당경찰서에 고발했다. 그러나 경찰은 고발 사흘 만에 이 총장 사건을 분당경찰서에서 경기남부경찰청 반부패경제범죄수사대로 이첩했다. 명예훼손 혐의는 통상 일선 경찰서 수사과에서 담당하는데, 이 총장 사건은 특별히 상급 기관으로 넘겨 특별·공안 수사 부서에 배당해 당시 논란이 있었다.)

Based on statements from Secretary-General Lee and witnesses, the police are understood to have determined that the video posted by Lee did not rise to the level of defaming Deputy Secretary Kim's reputation. Since defamation is a crime that cannot be punished against the victim's will, and Deputy Secretary Kim did not express such opposition, the police reportedly proceeded with the actual investigation. (경찰은 이 총장과 참고인 등의 진술을 바탕으로 이 총장이 올린 영상이 김 실장의 명예를 훼손할 수 있는 정도가 아니라고 본 것으로 알려졌다. 명예훼손죄는 반의사불벌죄라 김 실장이 원하지 않으면 형사처벌이 불가한데 김 실장이 그런 의사를 표하지 않아 경찰이 실제 수사에 나선 것으로 알려졌다.)
